svg.title: How the earlier folders and the domains of thought meet the live account
svg.desc: 1,183 claims from 16 earlier folders and 12 domains of thought, each read against the live account. It states 491 in whole or in part and takes up 189 to say otherwise. 376 it does not state: a reader proposes the connection here. 105 it does not take up, and 22 stand only in its history. Every thread is an AI reading, and no person’s. Of 337 agreements, 130 are with a checked law, 67 with a thesis or method, and 140 rest on a reader’s join. A thread is not proof, a shared word is not a correspondence, and agreement is drawn no more prominently than divergence. 328 entries rest on the AI’s knowledge of a text not stored here, unchecked against that text. A random check of 100 entries estimates that about 14.2% of all carry a wrong label or target role and 3.2% a wrong reading (How it was read).
svg.text: How the earlier folders and the domains of thought meet the live account
Drawn by connection_map.py from the crosswalk’s 1,183 claims, each read against the live account. A thread
joins an earlier folder or a domain of thought to the part of the account its claims are read against.
Every thread is an AI reading, no person’s. A thread is not proof, and agreement is drawn no more prominently than divergence.
3 carried · 488 in part · 189 changed · 376 proposed here · 22 only in history · 105 not carried
Where the account takes them up
間 and 文言 as formal language
The relational self and 大同
The selfishness spiral and narrative-value frames
Spirit, Token, Space and the Yi substrate
Cooperative abundance and freely built worlds
智善: intelligence must be good
A thread’s width grows with its claims; a lighter thread is a connection the account does not state, proposed here. The 127 claims only in history
or not carried draw no thread. Beside a folder or domain the number counts its claims; beside a part of the account, the claims read against it.
Every claim with its targets and their standings: the crosswalk below. The same data to explore: map.html beside this file, which GitHub shows only as source.
